wiki.title: Lesly Muñoz
wiki.extract: Lesly Muñoz is an American labor organizer and Democratic politician currently serving in the Oregon House of Representatives, having first been elected in 2024. She represents the 22nd district, which is entirely within Marion County and consists of Hayesville, Gervais, and Woodburn as well as parts of Keizer and Salem.
